# UEN Digital Press with Pressbooks

> A Utah-based open educational resources publishing platform enabling educators to create, discover, and share openly-licensed textbooks and course materials.

UEN Digital Press leverages Pressbooks technology to provide Utah educators and institutions with tools for publishing and accessing open educational resources. The platform supports the creation and distribution of openly-licensed textbooks and educational content aligned with institutional needs.

## Key Topics

- Open Educational Resources (OER)
- Pressbooks Platform
- Open Textbooks
- OER Publishing
- Book Cloning
- User Authentication
- Account Registration
- Getting Started
- Educational Content
- Institutional Login
- Training and Webinars
- Pressbooks Directory
- Password Recovery
- Utah Education Network

## Getting Started

- [UEN Digital Press Homepage](https://uen.pressbooks.pub): Main entry point for UEN Digital Press, featuring overview of the Pressbooks-based OER publishing platform for Utah
- [Catalog](https://uen.pressbooks.pub/catalog): Searchable catalog of open educational resources and textbooks published via UEN Digital Press

## Account Management

- [Log In](https://uen.pressbooks.pub/wp/wp-login.php): User authentication and login portal for existing UEN Digital Press accounts
- [Sign Up](https://uen.pressbooks.pub/wp-signup.php): Account registration and signup page for new UEN Digital Press users
